title: Run Ethical Exit Data Export
description: Export complete business data with transparent, fee-free access following the Ethical Exit principle.
prerequisites: You have admin-level data export permissions.
You know the required export scope and retention destination.
A secure storage destination is prepared for exported archives.
steps: Open data governance or export settings and choose full Ethical Exit export mode.
Select required datasets, including operational ledger, contact directory, and document history.
Run a pre-export validation to confirm no permission blockers or missing scopes.
Start export and monitor completion status for each dataset package.
Download and store archives in approved secure storage with integrity checks.
Validate exported files can be opened and reconciled against in-system counts before offboarding.
validations: All selected datasets are included in the export archive.
Record counts in exported data match system totals.
No hidden fees or blocked export paths are encountered.
commonErrors: Export scope omits key dataset families.
Archive completes but file integrity validation fails.
User role lacks permission to initiate full export.
recovery: Re-run export with full dataset selection and confirm scope checklist.
Regenerate corrupted archive segments and recompute checksums.
Temporarily elevate admin permissions for final export execution and audit logging.

faq.question: Can I export everything if I leave the platform?
faq.answer: Yes. Ethical Exit supports full export of operational, financial, and document history data.

faq.question: What should I verify before offboarding?
faq.answer: Verify completeness, integrity, and readability of exported archives against system counts.
